The series has unstable ranking and strong outliers; a simple mean over the full pool may provide robustness.
test a robust weighted scheme using softmax_neg_error on the full pool, to see if a different weighting method improves over inverse_error on pool4.
Try a robust weighted combination over the full pool using inverse-error weights to see if broader coverage improves over the current best.
The series has unstable ranking and high outliers; a trimmed mean over the full pool may provide robustness against extreme models.
The ranking is unstable and several models share correlated errors; a robust DBA over a stable subset may capture complementary strengths better than weighted combos.
Test a per‑horizon weighted combination on the full pool to see if horizon‑specific strengths help; the series has unstable ranking and many correlated groups.
Use a per‑horizon weighted scheme on the stable pool4 to exploit possible horizon‑specific strengths, addressing the unstable ranking and hint for robustness.

decision.justification: Selected 'mean on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.788. Series context: trend strength 0.5555 and seasonal strength 0.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.06); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.477.
